doorbell-ring-notify.title: Doorbell ring notification
doorbell-ring-notify.description: Sends a critical notification when the selected doorbell sensor rings. Works with real doorbells and virtual doorbell sensors.
doorbell-ring-notify.author: camera.ui

front-door-person-alert.title: Front door person alert
front-door-person-alert.description: Sends a notification whenever a person is detected on the selected camera.
front-door-person-alert.author: camera.ui

motion-night-snapshot-notify.title: Motion at night, snapshot and notify
motion-night-snapshot-notify.description: During night hours, captures a fresh snapshot on motion and sends it as a notification.
motion-night-snapshot-notify.author: camera.ui

mqtt-doorbell.title: MQTT doorbell
mqtt-doorbell.description: Rings a doorbell sensor when a matching MQTT message arrives, e.g. from a Shelly, Tasmota or Zigbee2MQTT device. The trigger matches a value inside the JSON payload, so on/off devices ring exactly once per press. Works great with a virtual doorbell sensor. Requires MQTT to be enabled in the settings.
mqtt-doorbell.author: camera.ui

person-detected-notifier-plugin.title: Person detected, snapshot to notifier
person-detected-notifier-plugin.description: When a person is detected, captures a fresh snapshot and sends it to the selected notification targets, e.g. push devices, email (SMTP plugin) or a messenger provided by a notifier plugin.
person-detected-notifier-plugin.author: camera.ui

webhook-doorbell.title: Webhook doorbell
webhook-doorbell.description: Rings a doorbell sensor whenever the webhook is called, e.g. by a smart button or a third-party system. Works great with a virtual doorbell sensor.
webhook-doorbell.author: camera.ui
